title: On the Finsler variational nature of autoparallels in metric-affine geometry
summary: In metric-affine geometry, autoparallels are generically non-variational, i.e., they are not the extremals of any action integral. The existence of a parametrization-invariant action principle for autoparallels is a long-standing open problem, which is equivalent to the so-called Finsler metrizability of the connection -- that is, to the fact that these autoparallels can be interpreted as Finsler geodesics.
